package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/ethproof"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality"
)

type probeCase struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
}
type probeOut struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Parsed   bool   `json:"parsed"`
	Nil      bool   `json:"nil"`
	Verifies bool   `json:"verifies"`
	Code     string `json:"code"`
}

func TestZZProbe(t *testing.T) {
	in := os.Getenv("PROBE_IN")
	out := os.Getenv("PROBE_OUT")
	if in == "" || out == "" {
		t.Fatal("PROBE_IN and PROBE_OUT name the files")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(in)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []probeCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var res []probeOut
	for _, c := range cases {
		var s *ethproof.Settlement
		o := probeOut{Name: c.Name}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.Text), &s); err == nil {
			o.Parsed = true
			o.Nil = s == nil
			_, derr := finality.DeriveIncluded(finality.ChainBaseSepolia, s)
			o.Verifies = derr == nil
			if n, ok := finality.AsNamed(derr); ok {
				o.Code = n.Code
			}
		}
		res = append(res, o)
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(res)
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, b, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
